integrity: Finite checks are not a proof of the limit laws; proof rests on singularity analysis and Gärtner–Ellis. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nilpotent height counts and their generating functions are prior literature. New assessed claim concerns large deviations and Gaussian rank fluctuations; complete text of directly comparable 2015 paper was unavailable, so priority remains provisional.
title: Large deviations of nilpotent partial-order-preserving injection ranks
